title: Nine Years and One Stone Wall
subtitle: 国防与防护 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 国防与防护（历史社会与文化·国防与安全）
meta: 主题语境：国防与防护（历史社会与文化·国防与安全）　|　核心词汇：defence　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 defence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1939 the commander ① planned a defence that no council in the county would have funded, and he said the planning was the whole of the garrison. The ② defence, meaning the protecting and not the wall, ran nine years and stayed unfunded on the map; a defence, he said, is the only thing in a garrison that is judged by how long it is left unbuilt.

Every ③ defence in that county had the same stone wall at the back of it, and the ④ defence at the end, meaning the one they kept for the harbour and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever tested twice. A defence, his deputy said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to plan; the commander said the patience is the part that fills nine years.

The lawyer meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ the defence was the whole of the case, meaning the plea and not the protecting. The ⑥ defence, meaning the plea and not any of that, is the only thing in a case that everybody argues and nobody proves; defence, she said, is either something you plan or the only word that means both a protecting and a plea. She said the plea is the part they remember.

By 1948 the ⑦ defence had become a line in an estimate, and the estimate had become an argument about the stone wall. The ⑧ defence of the whole thing, the commander wrote in March, was one county and nine years of planning; defence, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to plan. She said the planning was never mentioned.

The ⑨ defence I remember is the one at the end, which was completed in 1955 and is still described as the strangest in the county. A ⑩ defence, the deputy said in 1957, is the only thing that improves by being tested; every defence, she said, is a plea that has agreed to look like a protecting. She said the plea was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 防御工事；防线（指郡里构筑的那一道）
B. n. 防御（指那种防护行为本身，与那道墙相对）
C. 固定搭配：plan a defence 筹划一道防御
D. n. 防御工事（指留给港口用的那一道）
E. n. 防御；防务（抽象总称，指一个郡的全部防务）
F. n. 防务（指预算书上写到、被列支的那一笔）
G. n. 辩护；答辩（指案子里提出的那份申辩）
H. n. 答辩（抽象总称，指人人论辩却无人证实的那一份）

items.q: planned a defence that no council in the county would have funded
The defence, meaning the protecting and not the wall
the defence was the whole of the case
the defence had become a line in an estimate
The defence of the whole thing
A defence, the deputy said in 1957

answers.why: plan a defence 意为“筹划一道防御”，1939 年司令官筹划了一道全郡没有一处议会肯出资的防御。
defence 意为“防御”，指那种防护行为本身而不是那道墙，它在地图上搁了九年而没有经费。
defence 意为“防御工事”，指那个郡里每一道防御，每一道背后都有同一堵石墙。
defence 意为“防御工事”，指留给港口用的那一道，是唯一有人检验过两次的。
defence 意为“辩护、答辩”，指案子里提出的那份申辩，律师说这份答辩就是那个案子的全部。
defence 意为“答辩”，指人人论辩却无人证实的那一份而不是那种防护行为，是案子里人人都论辩、却无人证实的东西。
defence 意为“防务”，指预算书上写到、被列支的那一笔，到 1948 年这笔防务成了预算书里的一行。
defence 意为“防御、防务”，司令官三月写道，整件事的防务是一个郡和九年的筹划。
defence 意为“防御工事”，我记得的是末尾那一道，1955 年建成，至今仍被说成全郡最奇的一道。
defence 为抽象总称，副官 1957 年说，一道防御是唯一会因为被检验而变得更好的东西。
